text.Konut Kredisi Rehberi: Peşinat, Eksperti: Home Loan Guide: Down Payment, Property Appraisal and Choosing a Term - KredimGeldi
text.Konut kredisinde peşinat, ekspertiz, tap: Down payment, property appraisal, title deed costs, DASK, choosing a term and early repayment rules for home loans. Everything you need to know when buying a home, in one article.
text.Konut kredisi, çoğu insanın hayatı boyun: A home loan is the largest and longest-term loan most people will ever take out. That's why you need to look not only at the interest rate but also at the down payment, additional costs and how it will affect your budget over the long run.
text.Konut kredisi nasıl işler?: How does a home loan work?
text.Peşinat ne kadar olmalı?: How much should the down payment be?
text.Peşinat ne kadar yüksekse kredi tutarı,: The higher your down payment, the lower the loan amount and therefore the total interest. But don't put all your savings into the down payment; keep a reserve for the title deed, moving and unexpected expenses.
text.Başvurunuz ön onay aldıktan sonra banka,: Once your application is pre-approved, the bank sends an appraiser licensed by the SPK (Capital Markets Board) to inspect the home. The appraiser determines a value by assessing the home's location, age, square footage, occupancy permit status and comparable sales. The appraisal fee is usually paid by the customer.
text.Ekspertiz değeri satış fiyatının altında: If the appraised value comes in below the sale price, the loan amount available to you also drops. That's why it's helpful to research comparable prices in the area in advance when choosing a home. Getting a loan can be more difficult for homes without an occupancy permit or a building registration certificate.
text.Krediden başka hangi masraflar var?: What other costs are there besides the loan?
text.Beyan edilen satış bedelinin toplam %4'ü: A total of 4% of the declared sale price. Usually split equally between the buyer and the seller.
text.Tapu işlemleri sırasında alınan sabit bi: A fixed service fee charged during title deed transactions.
text.İpoteğin tapuya işlenmesi için alınan ma: Charges for registering the mortgage on the title deed.
text.Zorunlu deprem sigortası. Kredi kullanım: Compulsory earthquake insurance. A policy is required to take out the loan.
text.Bankalar genellikle ister. Poliçeyi fark: Usually required by banks. You can take out the policy with a different company and submit it.
At most 0.5% (5 per thousand) of the loan amount.
text.Vade seçimi: Kısa mı, uzun mu?: Choosing a term: Short or long?
text.Konut kredilerinde vade 120 aya kadar çı: Since home loan terms can extend up to 120 months, your choice of term has a very large impact. For example, for a 2,000,000 TL loan at 2.49% monthly interest, the approximate figures are:
text.Vadeyi iki katına çıkarmak taksidi yakla: Doubling the term lowers the installment by about 19%, while increasing the total repayment by more than 2.4 million TL. Choosing the shortest term with an installment you can comfortably pay saves you a significant amount in the long run.
text.Gelirinizi belgeleyen evraklar, kimlik,: Documents proving your income, your ID, a copy of the title deed or the preliminary sales agreement, and the details of the home will speed up the application process.
text.Konut fiyatını ve vadeyi girin; bankalar: Enter the home price and term, and compare banks' home loan installments.
text.Konut kredisinde KKDF ve BSMV var mı?: Are KKDF and BSMV charged on home loans?
text.Hayır. Bireysel konut kredileri bu vergi: No. Consumer home loans are exempt from these taxes.
text.Ekspertiz değeri düşük çıkarsa ne olur?: What happens if the appraised value comes in low?
text.Banka kredi tutarını ekspertiz değerine: The bank sets the loan amount based on the appraised value. If the value comes in low, you may need to put down a larger down payment or renegotiate the price with the seller.
text.Bankanın istediği sigortayı başka şirket: Can I get the insurance the bank requires from another company?
text.Evet. Konut ve hayat sigortası gibi poli: Yes. You can take out policies such as home and life insurance with any insurance company you choose and submit them to the bank; DASK, however, is compulsory.

html.Banka, satın alacağınız evin değerinin b: The bank lends you a certain portion of the value of the home you are buying and places a mortgage on the property. Once the loan is fully repaid, the mortgage is lifted. Since consumer home loans are exempt from KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund) and BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax), the advertised interest rate is used directly to calculate the installment.
html.Bankalar kredi tutarını evin satış fiyat: Banks calculate the loan amount based not on the home's sale price but on the value determined in the appraisal report. The maximum ratio available (the loan-to-value ratio) is set by BDDK (Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency) regulations and may vary depending on the value and characteristics of the home. You need to cover the remaining amount yourself as a down payment.
html.Konut kredinizi vadesinden önce kapatabi: You can pay off your home loan before the end of its term. On fixed-rate home loans, the bank may charge an early repayment fee; this amount cannot exceed 1% of the principal repaid early if the remaining term is 36 months or less, or 2% if it is more than 36 months. No early repayment fee may be charged on variable-rate home loans.
